clauses.title: Financial Covenants
clauses.operativeSummary: (a) Consolidated Leverage Ratio must not exceed 3.75 to 1.00, with elective Material Step-Up Acquisition increase to 4.25 to 1.00 for the acquisition quarter and three succeeding quarters, at most twice during the term, with two consecutive 3.75 quarter-ends before a second step-up. (b) Consolidated Interest Coverage Ratio must not be less than 3.00 to 1.00.
